subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Students visited the compost center and saw food waste becoming dark soil.”?
options: The debate changed how students saw ordinary objects.
The project changed how students saw trees near water.
The next morning, students saw him differently.
The process changed how they saw leftovers.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The debate changed how students saw ordinary objects.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The project changed how students saw trees near water.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The next morning, students saw him differently.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Students visited the compost center and saw food waste becoming dark soil. The process changed how they saw leftovers.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Students visited the compost center and saw food waste becoming dark soil. The process changed how they saw leftovers.」，答案為「The process changed how they saw leftovers.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The process changed how they saw leftovers.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
